title: Value of a circuit gate
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers with $k\le n$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. For every natural number $j<\mathrm{total}(n,k)$, the value at vertex $n+j$ after evaluating the circuit formed by the gates is the evaluation of the gate at position $j$ on the resulting list of vertex values.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$-bit inputs
